title: Read a JSON request
summary: Ruby on Rails: Read a JSON request. Send an empty object.
introduction: Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}. Rails puts body values in params.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON request with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Read a JSON request
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
post "/books", to: "lesson#create"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def create
 if !params[:title].is_a?(String)
  render json: { error: "Title needed" }, status: :bad_request
  return
 end
 render json: { title: params[:title] }, status: :created
end
end

blocks.text: The title parameter is a String. The action sends it with created status instead of taking the error branch.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: This example returns data but does not save a database record.
